svg.title: Avid EX 24.1 ClearPath retrofit individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.

text.tspan: Avid EX 24.1 ClearPath retrofit · individual conductor plan

svg.text: Dotted = GUESS / proposed conversion, verify before energizing · Green = retained source path · Broken = OPEN
Each circle is one named physical pin, terminal or identified lead. Connector orientation and fitted revision must match.
Crossing lines are not junctions. Connections exist only at the named terminal circles and explicitly shared nets.

text.tspan: Smoothieboard V2 Core supply inlet: P1 J42

svg.text: Core P1 J42.1 and J42.2 exported nets are /5VPORTIN and GND. J42.1 is an input contact, not a supply output; actual
acceptable supply range is a revision-specific commissioning check.

text.tspan: ClearPath command buffer #1: Core STEP/DIR → AHCT125 → Avid J8/J9

svg.text: TI SN74AHCT125 pin map shown for 14-pin D/N/NS/PW family: pin14 +5V, pin7 GND; gates (1A pin2→1Y pin3, /OE pin1; 2A pin5→2Y
pin6, /OE pin4; 3A pin9→3Y pin8, /OE pin10; 4A pin12→4Y pin11, /OE pin13). /OE low passes data; set enables only with
reviewed power-up/reset behavior. Chip must be decoupled at its supply. Explicit supply proposal: each AHCT125 pin14 receives
a dedicated regulated +5V rail, pin7 returns to common star, with 100nF ceramic placed directly from pin14 to pin7. All /OE
pins are active-low and shown tied to GND (always enabled) only as a test-gated proposal; confirm boot waveform and keep
servo power disabled until output is stable. Grounds are represented once per physical connector contact.

text.tspan: ClearPath command buffer #2: Core STEP/DIR → AHCT125 → Avid J8/J9

svg.text: TI SN74AHCT125 pin map shown for 14-pin D/N/NS/PW family: pin14 +5V, pin7 GND; gates (1A pin2→1Y pin3, /OE pin1; 2A pin5→2Y
pin6, /OE pin4; 3A pin9→3Y pin8, /OE pin10; 4A pin12→4Y pin11, /OE pin13). /OE low passes data; set enables only with
reviewed power-up/reset behavior. Chip must be decoupled at its supply. Explicit supply proposal: each AHCT125 pin14 receives
a dedicated regulated +5V rail, pin7 returns to common star, with 100nF ceramic placed directly from pin14 to pin7. All /OE
pins are active-low and shown tied to GND (always enabled) only as a test-gated proposal; confirm boot waveform and keep
servo power disabled until output is stable. Grounds are represented once per physical connector contact.

text.tspan: Three AHCT125 devices: explicit +5V, return and bypass paths

svg.text: SN74AHCT125 datasheet identifies pin14=VCC, pin7=GND, operating supply 4.5–5.5V. This panel gives each of the three devices
its own explicit supply pins and local 100nF capacitor. A common return star is a wiring proposal, not source-established
isolation behavior; only join Core returns and Avid J7.1 COM after verifying exact receiver grounding. The individual driver
panels additionally show each signal input, active-low OE, output and pin map.

text.tspan: Drive enable candidate: third AHCT125 channel

svg.text: AHCT125 #3: pin14=regulated +5V, pin7=GND, 100nF local bypass. /OE pin1 is active-low; tied to common ground in this
test-gated wiring so channel passes data. Verify /MOT_EN polarity and downstream ENA behavior; this MCU signal is not an
E-stop. Keep motor power disabled until no-glitch reset tests pass.

svg.text: Avid 24.1 connector schedule labels pins 1 HLFB+, 2-4 +5V, 5 HLFB-, 6 STEP, 7 DIR, 8 ENABLE. This is the Avid-to-servo cable,
not Core header wiring; preserve as documented only after revision match.
